_about: Hand-kept list: which tariff the networks' own tariff documents name for trips ENTIRELY inside a zone that two networks share. Read by tools/nova-import/derive.ts (step network-zones): for these zones the document decides the flag `own`, not the rule computed from the stops. Add an entry only with the paragraph it comes from. `zones` are the zones of `alliance`; `tariff` is the alliance whose tariff applies inside them.

sources.T651.11: unireso, Conditions générales de vente T651.11, edition 01.06.2026, https://www.unireso.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/CGV-unireso-Juin-2026-1.pdf (read 2026-11-10); confirmed in the SBB shop on 2026-11-11 (packages/engine/data/zones/sbb-checks-leman-pass/RESULTS.md)

open: onde-verte 31 (La Ferrière/Sonvilier) and 66 (Cormoret/Chasseral), shared with Libero: T651.3 names only zones 42 and 65 as overlap zones 'sans primauté tarifaire' of Onde Verte, which suggests 31 and 66 are Onde Verte's own; no table says so and the Libero tariff T651.10 was not read. Left to the rule (not own).
libero 697 (Kerzers), all of its stops also Frimobil stops (zone 56): not in the list of T651.4 1.3.1; the Libero tariff T651.10 was not read. Left to the rule (not own).
mobilis 182 and 183 hold Les Avants, which Frimobil does not serve; they are marked not own because both tariffs give Frimobil the trips inside the shared part (Frimobil 23, 24).
Every other pair of networks (Libero, A-Welle, Passepartout, Zug, Schwyz, Ostwind, ZVV, Vagabond ...): no tariff read; flags come from the rule alone.
